t: Core Glossary: Laboratory First Aid — Signature Edition — Signature Method
title: Core Glossary: Laboratory First Aid — Signature Edition — Signature Method
description: Core Glossary: Laboratory First Aid — Signature Edition — Signature Method: the working vocabulary of Laboratory First Aid — Signature Edition: 10 terms with plain definitions, runnable as a demo. The Signature edition: the JAH system's original reference on Laboratory First Aid. Lab first aid acts: flush chemicals, treat burns, call for help. Training beats kits.
definition: Core Glossary: Laboratory First Aid — Signature Edition — Signature Method — the working vocabulary of Laboratory First Aid — Signature Edition: 10 terms with plain definitions, runnable as a demo..
key_points: SDS: Safety data sheet: hazards, handling and emergency info per chemical.
CHP: Chemical hygiene plan: the lab's written safety program.
PPE: Personal protective equipment matched to the hazard.
Exposure limit: The maximum allowed airborne concentration of a substance.
Spill kit: The stocked materials for containing a specific spill type.
Eyewash: The plumbed or bottled station flushing eyes within seconds.
Safety shower: The deluge shower for full-body chemical exposure.
Near miss: An incident that could have hurt someone but did not.
Risk assessment: Identifying hazards and judging likelihood and severity.
Hierarchy of controls: Elimination, substitution, engineering, admin, PPE — in that order.
